visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a brightly lit professional studio where a male character with short dark hair, wearing a white T-shirt and black pants, is seen adjusting a large black studio light mounted on a stand. He moves with focused precision. (2) The camera transitions to a medium shot of the man holding a black DSLR camera with a large lens, positioning it over a table crowded with numerous foundation bottles, brushes, and makeup palettes. (3) He looks through the camera's viewfinder, framing a shot of a female model seated in the background; his hands are steady as he operates the equipment. (4) A high-contrast professional advertisement shot appears, featuring a female model with sleek dark hair holding a small black eyebrow powder compact over her right eye against a clean grey background. (5) Another professional shot shows a different female model posing with the same makeup product, showcasing her smooth skin and sharp eyebrows. (6) A close-up shot follows, showing the man's hand using a small brush to carefully apply makeup to a model's eyebrow in a studio setting. (7) The man is then shown from behind, filming a model wearing a black off-the-shoulder dress as she poses with the product. (8) A wide shot captures the entire studio setup with multiple ring lights and softboxes surrounding the shooting area while the man adjusts the camera settings. (9) A series of quick cuts alternate between the man filming and the final high-quality photographic results, one including a camera UI overlay to simulate the viewfinder. (10) Finally, the man stands before the camera, smiling and using his hands to frame a shot while addressing the viewer; a table of makeup products is prominent in the foreground.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A well-groomed man with short black hair, wearing a clean white T-shirt and black trousers, appearing professional and energetic.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A professional photography studio environment containing various lighting equipment (softboxes, ring lights), a makeup vanity table filled with cosmetic products, and a neutral grey backdrop for professional portraits.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A confident male voice begins speaking in Mandarin over an upbeat, rhythmic electronic BGM. He speaks with high energy and clarity. The BGM has a steady synthesizer bassline and a crisp 4/4 drum beat. (2) As the narration continues, the speaker's pitch fluctuates expressively, conveying excitement about his 'new identity.' The BGM maintains its tempo, creating a professional yet energetic atmosphere. (3) The vocal delivery transitions into a descriptive phase where he explains the process of a product shoot. The BGM remains consistent in the background, perfectly balanced under the vocals. (4) A short, bright 'whoosh' sound effect emphasizes a visual transition between the behind-the-scenes footage and the professional model shots. The speaker's tone remains enthusiastic and authoritative. (5) In the final phase, the voice becomes more inviting, using a slightly higher pitch for a call to action. The BGM begins to fade slightly towards the end, punctuated by a realistic camera shutter SFX at the very close of the clip.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Behind-the-scenes Process -> Product Results -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote a new eyebrow powder product from 'KAI BEAUTY' by highlighting the versatile talents of its founder, Kai. It showcases his dual role as both the makeup artist and the professional photographer for the campaign, emphasizing personal dedication and brand authenticity to build a deeper connection with the audience.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of the product 'KAI BEAUTY eyebrow powder' and the creator stating it is his 'own brand' (自家眉粉新品).

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a 'multi-talented founder' narrative to build brand trust. The fast-paced editing and bright studio aesthetics align with modern social media marketing for beauty products.
